articles.title: "Not negotiating": Trump says "something will happen fairly soon" with Iran, as US mulls fresh strikes
articles.description: US President Donald Trump indicated that there are no negotiations occurring with Iran at this time. He mentioned that something significant will happen fairly soon, possibly after the midterm elections. Reports suggest that the US and Israel have developed plans for potential military strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities and infrastructure. Iran has warned of retaliation, anticipating a new weapon, the 'Father of All Bombs.'

articles.title: US and Israel plan renewed strikes on Iran
articles.description: US and Israel draw up plans for renewed strikes on Iran after the American elections, according to officials briefed on the talks. Read more at straitstimes.com.

articles.title: US, Israel plan post-election Iran strikes as Hegseth meets Netanyahu
articles.description: US and Israel plan renewed Iran strikes after November 3 midterms. Defense Secretary Hegseth met Netanyahu this week to discuss options. Iran prolongs talks to deny Trump diplomatic win before elections. WTI crude rose 0.96% to $98.76 per barrel amid Hormuz tensions.
